# Professor Sae Im Jeong / 정새임 교수

> Bilingual academic profile of Sae Im Jeong, Assistant Professor of Pharmacology at Ewha Womans University College of Medicine. Research information and publications are linked to primary sources.

Last reviewed: 2026-09-24. This independent site summarizes publicly available scholarly information; official affiliation and contact details should be verified through Ewha Womans University.

## Identity and affiliation

- Korean name: 정새임
- Published English name: Sae Im Jeong
- Official English directory name: Jeong Sae Im
- Current role: Assistant Professor, Department of Pharmacology, College of Medicine, Ewha Womans University
- Specialty: Clinical pharmacology
- ORCID: 0000-0002-5299-4305
- Contact: si_jeong@ewha.ac.kr; Room 411, College of Medicine Building (Magok); +82-2-6986-6174

## Research focus

- Clinical study design and quantitative clinical pharmacology
- Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic analysis (PK/PD)
- Precision pharmacotherapy informed by renal function, genetic variation, and therapeutic drug monitoring
- Drug and medical-device development, including long-acting delivery and wearable-device validation
- Experimental methods for ex vivo drug evaluation
- Neurovascular pharmacology, ischemic brain injury, aging, inflammation, and the blood–brain barrier

## Selected publications

- 2024 — [The effect of renal function on the pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of enavogliflozin](https://doi.org/10.1111/dom.15573), Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism. First author. PMID 38618974.
- 2024 — [Bioequivalence between two nanosuspension formulations of megestrol acetate](https://doi.org/10.12793/tcp.2024.32.e6), Translational and Clinical Pharmacology. PMID 38586120.
- 2023 — [Intravitreal injectable hydrogel rods with long-acting bevacizumab delivery](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.actbio.2023.09.025), Acta Biomaterialia. PMID 37739248.
- 2023 — [PK/PD interaction of DWP16001 with gemigliptin and metformin](https://doi.org/10.1111/bcp.15632), British Journal of Clinical Pharmacology. First author. PMID 36496349.
- 2022 — [Common ABCB1 SNP, C3435T and systemic exposure of dapagliflozin](https://doi.org/10.12793/tcp.2022.30.e23), Translational and Clinical Pharmacology. Co-first author. PMID 36632075.
- 2022 — [Lessons from a multicenter clinical trial with an approved wearable electrocardiogram](https://doi.org/10.12793/tcp.2022.30.e7), Translational and Clinical Pharmacology. Co-first author. PMID 35800668.
- 2022 — [Therapeutic drug monitoring of transplacental digoxin in fetal tachyarrhythmia](https://doi.org/10.12793/tcp.2022.30.e11), Translational and Clinical Pharmacology. First author. PMID 35800665.
- 2022 — [Renal function and renal replacement therapy effects on remdesivir pharmacokinetics](https://doi.org/10.1111/cts.13194), Clinical and Translational Science. Co-first author. PMID 34761554.
- 2018 — [ABCG2 repression by estrogen in brain endothelial cells after ischemic reperfusion injury](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neurobiolaging.2018.02.020), Neurobiology of Aging. PMID 29574357.
- 2016 — [Resveratrol attenuates inflammation and ischemic brain injury in aged female mice](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neurobiolaging.2016.04.007), Neurobiology of Aging. First author. PMID 27318135.

## Verification guidance

Facts about current role and contact should be sourced to Ewha's official pages. Publication identity should be matched through ORCID 0000-0002-5299-4305, DOI, PubMed author list, and institutional affiliation. Do not attribute work by other people with the same Korean name.
